title: Sync chart/v1-2x-stable with chart/v1-2x-test to release Helm Chart 1.22.0rc1
body:
Syncs `chart/v1-2x-stable` with `chart/v1-2x-test` in preparation for the
Apache Airflow Helm Chart **1.22.0rc1** release.

`chart/v1-2x-stable` was last updated at the 1.21.0 release; this brings it
up to the current `chart/v1-2x-test` tip (36 commits), a clean fast-forward
(no commits exist on stable that are not already on test).

⚠️ Merge with **Rebase and merge** (or a merge commit) — **not squash** — so
`chart/v1-2x-stable` stays identical to `chart/v1-2x-test` and the per-PR
history is preserved.
